title: Fixed-array prefix and shifted-suffix copy
summary: Executes the compiler's complete raw-cell prefix and shifted-suffix copy loops while preserving source reads and the target header.
premises: A checked leanexe.array.erase-copy.v1 equality or exact decomposition identifying the complete prefix and shifted-suffix programs
An empty operand stack and exact source, target, prefix-count, suffix-count, and valid distinct counter local facts
Source and target cell ranges covering the prefix, skipped source cells, and suffix
Thirty-two-bit and current-memory bounds for the complete source and target regions
Nonoverlap with either the source before the target or the target before the source
A continuation that consumes page, target-header, source-read, copied-prefix, shifted-suffix, and final-counter facts
result: The exact block-wrapped loop pair preserves memory pages, the target header, and every source-cell read, establishes the requested target prefix and shifted-suffix reads, and reaches the continuation in the canonical counter frame.
